automation_workflow_trigger_receipts_sta.name: automation_workflow_trigger_receipts_state_check
automation_workflow_trigger_receipts_sta.value:
"automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."status" IN ('ready', 'consumed', 'expired', 'cancelled')
      AND (
        ("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."status" IN ('ready', 'expired')
          AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_run_id" IS NULL AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_at" IS NULL
          AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."status" = 'consumed'
          AND typeof("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_run_id") = 'text' AND length(trim("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_run_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
          AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."status" = 'cancelled'
          AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_run_id" IS NULL AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_at" IS NULL
          AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND typeof("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."cancel_reason") = 'text' AND length(trim("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."cancel_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)
      )

automation_workflow_trigger_receipts_tim.name: automation_workflow_trigger_receipts_time_check
automation_workflow_trigger_receipts_tim.value:
"automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."issued_at" >= 0 AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."available_at" >= 0 AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."expires_at" > "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."available_at"
      AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."updated_at" >= "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."issued_at"
      AND ("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_at" IS NULL OR ("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_at" >= "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."available_at" AND "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."consumed_at" < "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."expires_at"))
      AND ("automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."cancelled_at" IS NULL OR "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."cancelled_at" >= "automation_workflow_trigger_receipts"."issued_at")

automation_workflows_active_check.name: automation_workflows_active_check
automation_workflows_active_check.value: ("automation_workflows"."enabled" = 0 AND "automation_workflows"."active_revision_id" IS NULL) OR ("automation_workflows"."enabled" = 1 AND "automation_workflows"."active_revision_id" IS "automation_workflows"."current_revision_id")

cases_provider_projection_check.name: cases_provider_projection_check
cases_provider_projection_check.value:
"cases"."status" IN ('active', 'resolved', 'suppressed')
      AND length("cases"."provider_snapshot_hash") = 64
      AND "cases"."provider_snapshot_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'
      AND "cases"."provider_projected_at" > 0
      AND "cases"."event_count" >= 0
      AND "cases"."first_seen_at" >= 0
      AND "cases"."last_seen_at" >= "cases"."first_seen_at"
      AND "cases"."provider_event_classification" IN ('unclassified', 'customer_exception', 'onboarding_proof_exception')
      AND "cases"."last_trust_level" = 'customer_posthog'
      AND "cases"."last_credential_kind" = 'posthog_oauth'
      AND "cases"."revision" >= 1

identities_oidc_identity_check.name: identities_oidc_identity_check
identities_oidc_identity_check.value:
length("identities"."issuer") BETWEEN 8 AND 2048
      AND "identities"."issuer" LIKE 'https://%'
      AND length("identities"."subject") BETWEEN 1 AND 512
      AND ("identities"."email_verified" IS NULL OR "identities"."email_verified" IN (0, 1))
      AND "identities"."updated_at" >= "identities"."created_at"

mutation_commands_lease_pair_check.name: mutation_commands_lease_pair_check
mutation_commands_lease_pair_check.value: (("mutation_commands"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "mutation_commands"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("mutation_commands"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "mutation_commands"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "mutation_commands"."lease_expires_at" > 0))

onboarding_proof_sessions_lifecycle_chec.name: onboarding_proof_sessions_lifecycle_check
onboarding_proof_sessions_lifecycle_chec.value:
(
      ("onboarding_proof_sessions"."status" = 'active' AND "onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_at" IS NULL AND "onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_reason" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("onboarding_proof_sessions"."status" IN ('completed', 'revoked') AND "onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_at" >= "onboarding_proof_sessions"."started_at" AND "onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_at" < "onboarding_proof_sessions"."expires_at" AND "onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_reason")) > 0)
      OR
      ("onboarding_proof_sessions"."status" = 'expired' AND "onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_at" >= "onboarding_proof_sessions"."expires_at" AND "onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("onboarding_proof_sessions"."terminal_reason")) > 0)
    )

onboarding_states_json_check.name: onboarding_states_json_check
onboarding_states_json_check.value:
json_valid("onboarding_states"."plan_json") AND json_type("onboarding_states"."plan_json") = 'object'
      AND ("onboarding_states"."implementation_source_snapshot_json" IS NULL OR (json_valid("onboarding_states"."implementation_source_snapshot_json") AND json_type("onboarding_states"."implementation_source_snapshot_json") = 'object'))
      AND ("onboarding_states"."proof_session_json" IS NULL OR (json_valid("onboarding_states"."proof_session_json") AND json_type("onboarding_states"."proof_session_json") = 'object'))
      AND ("onboarding_states"."receipt_json" IS NULL OR (json_valid("onboarding_states"."receipt_json") AND json_type("onboarding_states"."receipt_json") = 'object'))

onboarding_states_status_documents_check.name: onboarding_states_status_documents_check
onboarding_states_status_documents_check.value:
(
      ("onboarding_states"."status" IN ('planned', 'approved') AND "onboarding_states"."implementation_source_snapshot_json" IS NULL AND "onboarding_states"."proof_session_json" IS NULL AND "onboarding_states"."receipt_json" IS NULL)
      OR ("onboarding_states"."status" = 'proving' AND "onboarding_states"."implementation_source_snapshot_json" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_states"."proof_session_json" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_states"."receipt_json" IS NULL)
      OR ("onboarding_states"."status" = 'verified' AND "onboarding_states"."implementation_source_snapshot_json" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_states"."proof_session_json" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_states"."receipt_json" IS NOT NULL)
    )

posthog_connections_lifecycle_check.name: posthog_connections_lifecycle_check
posthog_connections_lifecycle_check.value:
(
      ("posthog_connections"."status" = 'active'
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_iv" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_token_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_token_iv" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_expires_at" > 0
        AND "posthog_connections"."reauth_required_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."detached_at" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_connections"."status" = 'reauth_required'
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_iv" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_token_ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_token_iv" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_expires_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."reauth_required_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."detached_at" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_connections"."status" = 'detached'
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_iv" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_token_ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_token_iv" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."access_token_expires_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."detached_at" IS NOT NULL)
    )

posthog_connections_refresh_lease_check.name: posthog_connections_refresh_lease_check
posthog_connections_refresh_lease_check.value:
(
      ("posthog_connections"."refresh_lease_token" IS NULL AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_lease_expires_at" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_connections"."status" = 'active'
        AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_lease_token" IS NOT NULL
        AND length("posthog_connections"."refresh_lease_token") BETWEEN 16 AND 128
        AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."refresh_lease_expires_at" > 0)
    )

posthog_connections_identity_check.name: posthog_connections_identity_check
posthog_connections_identity_check.value:
((("posthog_connections"."posthog_region" = 'us' AND "posthog_connections"."posthog_host" = 'https://us.posthog.com')
        OR ("posthog_connections"."posthog_region" = 'eu' AND "posthog_connections"."posthog_host" = 'https://eu.posthog.com'))
      AND (
        ("posthog_connections"."status" = 'detached'
        AND "posthog_connections"."posthog_organization_id" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."posthog_environment_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("posthog_connections"."status" IN ('active', 'reauth_required')
        AND "posthog_connections"."posthog_environment_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_connections"."posthog_environment_id" > 0)
      ))

posthog_connections_timestamp_check.name: posthog_connections_timestamp_check
posthog_connections_timestamp_check.value:
length("posthog_connections"."oauth_client_id") BETWEEN 8 AND 2048
      AND ("posthog_connections"."oauth_client_id" LIKE 'https://%'
        OR "posthog_connections"."oauth_client_id" LIKE 'http://localhost%'
        OR "posthog_connections"."oauth_client_id" LIKE 'http://127.0.0.1%'
        OR "posthog_connections"."oauth_client_id" LIKE 'http://[::1]%')
      AND "posthog_connections"."authorized_at" > 0
      AND "posthog_connections"."version" >= 1
      AND "posthog_connections"."created_at" > 0
      AND "posthog_connections"."updated_at" >= "posthog_connections"."created_at"

posthog_connections_case_projection_curs.name: posthog_connections_case_projection_cursor_check
posthog_connections_case_projection_curs.value:
"posthog_connections"."case_projection_offset" >= 0
      AND ("posthog_connections"."case_projection_last_attempt_at" IS NULL OR "posthog_connections"."case_projection_last_attempt_at" > 0)
      AND ("posthog_connections"."case_projection_last_completed_at" IS NULL
        OR ("posthog_connections"."case_projection_last_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "posthog_connections"."case_projection_last_completed_at" > 0
          AND "posthog_connections"."case_projection_last_completed_at" <= "posthog_connections"."case_projection_last_attempt_at"))

posthog_oauth_attempts_secret_hash_check.name: posthog_oauth_attempts_secret_hash_check
posthog_oauth_attempts_secret_hash_check.value:
length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."oidc_nonce_hash") = 64
      AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."oidc_nonce_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."poll_token_hash" IS NULL OR (
        length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."poll_token_hash") = 64
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."poll_token_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'))
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_code_hash" IS NULL OR (
        length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_code_hash") = 64
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_code_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'))

posthog_oauth_attempts_authority_mode_ch.name: posthog_oauth_attempts_authority_mode_check
posthog_oauth_attempts_authority_mode_ch.value:
(
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."mode" = 'bootstrap'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."poll_token_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_redirect_uri" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_challenge" IS NOT NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."mode" = 'connect' AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."poll_token_hash" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_redirect_uri" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_challenge" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)
    )

posthog_oauth_attempts_secret_lifecycle_.name: posthog_oauth_attempts_secret_lifecycle_check
posthog_oauth_attempts_secret_lifecycle_.value:
(
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" IN ('pending', 'exchanging')
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pkce_verifier_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pkce_verifier_iv" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."oidc_nonce_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."oidc_nonce_iv" IS NOT NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" IN ('authorized', 'claimed', 'failed', 'expired')
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pkce_verifier_ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pkce_verifier_iv" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."oidc_nonce_ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."oidc_nonce_iv" IS NULL)
    )

posthog_oauth_attempts_pending_grant_che.name: posthog_oauth_attempts_pending_grant_check
posthog_oauth_attempts_pending_grant_che.value:
(
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" = 'authorized'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."mode" = 'bootstrap'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."project_id" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."connection_id" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_access_token_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_access_token_iv" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_refresh_token_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_refresh_token_iv" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_access_token_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_access_token_expires_at" > 0
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."posthog_host" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."posthog_environment_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."posthog_environment_id" > 0)
      OR
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" <> 'authorized'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_access_token_ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_access_token_iv" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_refresh_token_ciphertext" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_refresh_token_iv" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."pending_access_token_expires_at" IS NULL)
    )

posthog_oauth_attempts_handoff_lifecycle.name: posthog_oauth_attempts_handoff_lifecycle_check
posthog_oauth_attempts_handoff_lifecycle.value:
(
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."mode" = 'bootstrap' AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" = 'authorized'
        AND (
          ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."poll_consumed_at" IS NULL
            AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_code_hash" IS NOT NULL
            AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_expires_at" > 0
            AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_expires_at" = "posthog_oauth_attempts"."expires_at"
            AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_expires_at" <= "posthog_oauth_attempts"."authorized_at" + 300
            AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_failure_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 5)
          OR
          ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."poll_consumed_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_code_hash" IS NULL
            AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_expires_at" IS NULL
            AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_failure_count" = 0)
        ))
      OR
      (NOT ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."mode" = 'bootstrap' AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" = 'authorized')
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_code_hash" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_expires_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_failure_count" = 0)
    )

posthog_oauth_attempts_lifecycle_check.name: posthog_oauth_attempts_lifecycle_check
posthog_oauth_attempts_lifecycle_check.value:
(
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" = 'pending'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."exchange_started_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."connection_id" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."authorized_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."failed_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."expired_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."error_code" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" = 'exchanging'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."exchange_started_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."connection_id" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."authorized_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."failed_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."expired_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."error_code" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" = 'authorized'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."exchange_started_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."connection_id" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."authorized_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."claimed_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."failed_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."expired_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."error_code" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" = 'claimed'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."exchange_started_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."project_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."authorized_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."failed_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."expired_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."error_code" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" = 'failed'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."exchange_started_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."connection_id" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."authorized_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."expired_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."error_code" IS NOT NULL)
      OR
      ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."status" = 'expired'
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."connection_id" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."authorized_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."failed_at" IS NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."error_code" IS NULL)
    )

posthog_oauth_attempts_json_check.name: posthog_oauth_attempts_json_check
posthog_oauth_attempts_json_check.value:
json_valid("posthog_oauth_attempts"."requested_scopes_json")
      AND json_type("posthog_oauth_attempts"."requested_scopes_json") = 'array'
      AND length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."requested_scopes_json") <= 16384
      AND json_valid("posthog_oauth_attempts"."granted_scopes_json")
      AND json_type("posthog_oauth_attempts"."granted_scopes_json") = 'array'
      AND length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."granted_scopes_json") <= 16384
      AND json_valid("posthog_oauth_attempts"."capability_snapshot_json")
      AND json_type("posthog_oauth_attempts"."capability_snapshot_json") = 'object'
      AND length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."capability_snapshot_json") <= 65536
      AND json_valid("posthog_oauth_attempts"."error_metadata_json")
      AND json_type("posthog_oauth_attempts"."error_metadata_json") = 'object'
      AND length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."error_metadata_json") <= 16384

posthog_oauth_attempts_bounds_check.name: posthog_oauth_attempts_bounds_check
posthog_oauth_attempts_bounds_check.value:
length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."oauth_client_id") BETWEEN 8 AND 2048
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."oauth_client_id" LIKE 'https://%'
        OR "posthog_oauth_attempts"."oauth_client_id" LIKE 'http://localhost%'
        OR "posthog_oauth_attempts"."oauth_client_id" LIKE 'http://127.0.0.1%'
        OR "posthog_oauth_attempts"."oauth_client_id" LIKE 'http://[::1]%')
      AND length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."redirect_uri") BETWEEN 1 AND 2048
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_redirect_uri" IS NULL OR (
        length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_redirect_uri") BETWEEN 64 AND 256
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_redirect_uri" LIKE 'http://127.0.0.1:%/agentry/posthog/callback/%'))
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_challenge" IS NULL OR (
        length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_challenge") = 43
        AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_challenge" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'))
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."posthog_environment_id_hint" IS NULL OR "posthog_oauth_attempts"."posthog_environment_id_hint" > 0)
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."posthog_environment_id" IS NULL OR "posthog_oauth_attempts"."posthog_environment_id" > 0)
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."client_name" IS NULL OR length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."client_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."distribution_surface" IS NULL
        OR length("posthog_oauth_attempts"."distribution_surface") BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."last_polled_at" IS NULL OR "posthog_oauth_attempts"."last_polled_at" > 0)
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."poll_consumed_at" IS NULL OR "posthog_oauth_attempts"."poll_consumed_at" > 0)
      AND ("posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_expires_at" IS NULL OR "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_expires_at" > 0)
      AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."handoff_failure_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 5
      AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."expires_at" > "posthog_oauth_attempts"."created_at"
      AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."version" >= 1
      AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."created_at" > 0
      AND "posthog_oauth_attempts"."updated_at" >= "posthog_oauth_attempts"."created_at"
